facts.fact: Amrita 把 Jamie 的来电转进语音信箱，任他送的花在包装里枯萎。
facts.anchor: she’d sent his calls to voicemail and left his flowers to shrivel

facts.fact: 她想告诉 Sylvie 辞职是因为「魔——」，话被掐在喉咙里。
facts.anchor: ‘It’s because of the m—’ Her voice choked in her throat.

facts.fact: Mia 与 Aiden 承认婚礼无场地、无餐饮、无证婚人，请柬也全错。
facts.anchor: Which means we have no date. And the invites we did send out are all wrong.

facts.fact: 一本厚重的书像受伤的鸟在地上扑腾，自行翻到 Handfasting 一页。
facts.anchor: a heavy-looking book flopping around on the floor like an injured bird

facts.fact: Mia 主张等朋友与 Sylvie 都好起来，也许明年再办。
facts.anchor: ‘But later, when our friends aren’t in so much pain.

facts.fact: Mist 说帮忙的人要包括 Amrita、Elara 与更多人。
facts.anchor: We will need Amrita’s help too. And Elara’s. And many others.

facts.fact: Jamie 被魔法困在屋内，对魔法宣布放弃天赋。
facts.anchor: I’m not one of yours any more! I’m done. Take it away. All of it. I’m done.

facts.fact: 魔法倒空抽屉，花瓣落成心形围住一枚金色耳环。
facts.anchor: it was around a single golden earring
